fact: The regulator states the Union of the Comoros is linked to the world to the east by the FLY-LION 3 cable and to the west by the EASSY cable, a double connection that secures the country.
title: PLAIDOYER – UNION DES COMORES: Infrastructures efficientes et une meilleure connectivité au service de la transformation numérique en Union des Comores
publisher: ANRTIC (Autorité Nationale de Régulation des TIC)
